answer.reason: The verses tell of one event at Abarim: the LORD sent Moses up to view the promised land, while its other mentions are only camping stages.

clauses.english: was where the LORD sent Moses up to see the land given to Israel
clauses.quote: Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land

doubts: JER 22:20 is marked but the King James reads 'passages', not Abarim, so it was left out.
Israel's camping at Abarim (NUM 33:47-48) is only a stage of the journey and was not used.
